cells.gaps: The latest figure, nearly 70 per cent given by the minister in November 2026, is below 80 per cent.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-21: the communications minister put internet use at nearly 70 per cent of the population in November 2026 (DJI-006), a government figure for a share of people that replaces the ITU's 65.3 per cent for 2024. Past half and below 80 per cent, so 3.
